en-US.subtitle: Super App for Carnegie Mellon University
en-US.promoText: Super App for Carnegie Mellon University
en-US.description:
CMU Maps helps you get around Carnegie Mellon University.

1. Map
2. Building outlines
3. Interactive floor plans
4. Room cards with 25Live availability, dining info, and room images
5. Building cards with images
6. Waypoint-to-waypoint pathfinding and turn-based navigation
7. Search nearest rooms, dining (see what's open), restrooms, and classes
8. Upload your schedule

Made by ScottyLabs
